text: 48 builds in 3 weeks for the solana mobile hackathon. steal a seeker: a top down heist where you lift a seeker phone past guards who hear you, remember you and find bodies. submission goes in this week. level 1 in 20 seconds: @SolanaMobile @RadiantsDAO @StealASeeker
assets: 20 s gameplay clip of level 1, portrait, with the tap route visible

text: Steal a Seeker is a stealth heist game for the Seeker phone. Tap to move, flank a guard, take the phone, reach the exit. Every score is replayed and verified on the server. Built for CLOCK IN, the Solana Mobile hackathon. @SolanaMobile @RadiantsDAO
assets: 20 s gameplay clip of level 1, portrait, with the tap route visible

text: the thing i am proudest of: the guards. patrol loops, long narrow cones, they hear footsteps, they notice you before they see you, and when one finds a body the whole room changes. 30 ticks a second, deterministic, same code on the phone and the server. @StealASeeker
assets: 30 s clip: a guard hears a footstep, turns, searches, finds a body

text: Guards in Steal a Seeker do not just see. They hear, they get suspicious, they search where they last saw you, and they find what you leave behind. A short look at the guard brain.
assets: 30 s clip: a guard hears a footstep, turns, searches, finds a body

text: how the backend makes levels: a recipe is a few numbers. the server builds the room, a solver has to beat it, the verifier has to agree, then it becomes a permanent row. set one variable and the api publishes more. we went from 100 to 1000 overnight. @StealASeeker

how the leaderboard works: every run you submit is replayed on the server with the exact rules the level was published under. no replay, no points. the board is the sum of your best verified score per level. a level 40 player beats a level 4 player, always. @StealASeeker

text: Points are the sum of your best verified score on every level. Clean clears score higher. The board updates the moment your replay verifies.

why total points and not fastest time: fastest time rewards one perfect run on one level. total points rewards playing the whole game well. candy crush got this right. so did every arcade cabinet. @StealASeeker
Rank by everything you have done, not one lucky run. That is why the board counts total verified points.
